'''Mayu Watanabe''' (Japanese: '''{{tt|渡辺麻友|わたなべ まゆ}}''' ''Watanabe Mayu'') is the guest narrator of the [[PK26|26th]] [[Pikachu short]] of {{aniseries|PTS}}.

==Biography==
Mayu Watanabe was born March 26, 1994 in Saitama Prefecture, Japan. She was described as a shy child growing up, but at 13 years old she auditioned for an idol group in Akihabara, Tokyo. The group, {{wp|AKB48}}, was produced by the well known lyricist and producer {{wp|Yasushi Akimoto}}. In December 2006, Watanabe was accepted to be part of the third generation of AKB48 members along with 12 other girls. This group of girls was named as AKB48's "Team B", and Watanabe as named the team's "center". She appeared in nearly all of AKB48's singles while she was a member, and she was often placed near the front for the dance formations. She was voted the Most Popular AKB48 Member in 2014 during the group's yearly "election", where fans vote for their favorite member.

While working as an AKB48 member she had the opportunity to act in various dramas and movies. Her most prominent role was as the main character in Saba Doll, a comedy-drama series. She also did work as a voice actress in the anime series {{wp|AKB0048}} and the movie {{wp|Nerawareta Gakuen}}.

Watanabe left AKB48 on December 31st, 2017 to pursue an acting career. She went on to act in drama series such as "Black Scandal" and "Natsuzora ", until retiring from the entertainment industry in June 2020.
